reasoning: Claim is marked proposed on a proposed Book horizon, so as a proposal it is not an error. Its load-bearing premise is that the Special Draw Right is conditional on training outside apprentices. That condition appears only in E7 and E3, both agent_proposed. E1 confirms the Right and lineage crews carrying channel repair from Book 20, but states nothing on the condition, outside training or demonstrated repair. Those parts are proposals, not record. The tested-condition relation follows from E3's agent inference that the condition needs demonstrating.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: Offered quote is null. Read as record, the indicative 'are trained' and 'is demonstrated' would be present-tense events the cited items do not state. No cited item says an outside apprentice is trained or a repair is demonstrated. The condition is asserted only as agent-proposed text, not as record.
would_settle: A record element (not agent_proposed) stating the Right's training condition, or a later Book in which an outside apprentice is trained and a repair is shown.
creative_room: A proposed Book can stage outside apprentices trained under the Right, a repair demonstrated, and a test of its condition, and ask what the lineage must then carry. Treat the condition, the training and the demonstration as proposals, not record. Other readings of the labour stay open.
